decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to this premium stollen, it received positive external recognition again in 2024, and under escalation of commitment management is very likely to continue backing a visibly successful seasonal flagship.

This bread stayed on its own product page across 2023 and 2024, indicating continued investment and commitment in a core bakery category, so management would likely persist unless results clearly deteriorate.

Although seasonal and without a cited award, the marzipan stollen remained prominently presented for two years, and escalation of commitment makes management inclined to retain a publicly backed festive product unless weakness becomes unmistakable.
